translations.web: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.
